edits.new: After each test, record its date, results, gaps, and remediation, then update recovery procedures after exercises or infrastructure changes. MongoDB's business continuity guidance calls for keeping historical test execution dates and results, issues identified and remediation status, and procedure changes based on test learnings, and for reviewing and updating documentation after each test exercise or infrastructure change. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/business-continuity-planning.md

evidence.quote:
- Practice restoring from backups in non-production environments.

- Document actual recovery times and compare to RTO.

- Verify restored data integrity.

- Data loss aligns with expected RPO.

- All dependencies (networks, credentials) work correctly.

Some common tests that should be performed
are checking if all data is available, is not corrupted, is accessible, and that any data loss falls within the RPO for the workload.

Restoring a backup, but not querying or retrieving any data to
check that the restoration is usable.

edits.old: A completed backup job or stored backup object does not establish usable recovery. AWS warns against assuming an existing backup is operational or meets RTO/RPO; MongoDB recommends manual restore tests; Percona's MongoDB Operator v1.23.0 guide says an object is restorable only after it reaches `ready` and recommends practising a restore. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-08)
edits.new: A completed backup job or stored backup object does not establish usable recovery. AWS warns against assuming an existing backup is operational or meets RTO/RPO; MongoDB recommends practising restores from backups in non-production environments; Percona's MongoDB Operator v1.23.0 documents a backup as completed successfully when its status.state is ready, and its example is to start a restore after a backup is ready. Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2023-04-10/framework/rel_backing_up_data_periodic_recovery_testing_data.html ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/business-continuity-planning.md ; https://docs.percona.com/percona-operator-for-mongodb/1.23.0/cr-statuses.html
